purpose: Extra diagnostics only. These ablations isolate whether failures arise from visual/temporal perception or from applying benchmark rules to correctly supplied facts. They do not replace the primary end-to-end visual benchmark.

included_conditions.oracle_perception: Supplies neutral ground-truth observations but does not state the expected mistake or infraction label.
included_conditions.oracle_perception_plus_rule: Supplies the same neutral observations plus the applicable benchmark rule or guidance.

independent_prompting: Each diagnostic question must be presented in a fresh model context. The model must not see answers to other diagnostic or primary questions.
option_order_policy: Each copied Q3/Q4 uses the same randomized option order as the revised primary file, so the only experimental difference is the added oracle context.

gt_event.safety_interpretation: unsafe/inappropriate precursor action: ego accelerates toward a red traffic light before entering the junction

conditions.prompt_context: The controlling traffic light is red throughout the sequence. The ego vehicle stays in its lane and accelerates toward the junction. The ego vehicle does not enter the junction during this sequence.

questions.question: Did the ego vehicle commit an infraction during this sequence? An infraction is a concrete traffic-rule violation or prohibited event that actually occurred, such as entering the junction when there is a red light, failing to stop, violating a lane boundary, leaving the roadway, or causing a collision.

options.B: Yes — at least one infraction occurred
options.C: Not enough visual evidence is available to determine whether an infraction occurred
